title: There is / There are (~이 있다)
goal: '근처에 마트가 있어요', '방이 세 개 있어요'처럼 어디에 무엇이 있는지 말하고 물어볼 수 있어요.

points.title: There is / There are = ~이 있어요
points.body: 어디에 무엇이 있다고 말할 때 There is / There are로 시작해요. 여기서 there는 '거기'라는 뜻이 아니라 문장을 여는 말이에요.

points.title: 하나면 is, 여러 개면 are
points.body: 하나이거나 milk·water처럼 셀 수 없는 것은 There is(There's), 둘 이상이면 There are를 써요. There is a café. / There are two cafés.

points.title: 없어요 = isn't / aren't
points.body: '~이 없어요'는 There isn't / There aren't예요. any와 같이 쓰면 '하나도 없어요'라는 느낌이에요. There aren't any eggs. / There isn't any milk.

points.title: 있어요? = Is there / Are there
points.body: is/are를 there 앞으로 옮기면 질문이에요. Is there a bus stop near here? 대답은 Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.처럼 해요.

formula: There is (There's) + 하나 / 셀 수 없는 것

mistakes.why: There is를 한 덩어리로 외워서 개수를 신경 안 쓰기 쉬워요. 뒤에 오는 것이 둘 이상이면 are예요.

mistakes.wrong: Have a bus stop near here?
mistakes.right: Is there a bus stop near here?
mistakes.why: '있어요?'를 have로 바로 옮기는 실수예요. 장소에 무엇이 있는지 물을 땐 Is there / Are there로 물어요.
milk는 하나, 둘 셀 수 없는 것이라 is를 써요. water, bread, sugar도 마찬가지예요.

examples.en: There's a café next to my share house.
There are three bedrooms in this house.
examples.ko: 이 집에는 방이 세 개 있어요.

examples.en: There's some milk in the fridge.
There isn't a tram stop near my house.
examples.ko: 우리 집 근처에는 트램 정류장이 없어요.

examples.en: Is there a supermarket near here?
Are there any jobs at the farm?
Is there Wi-Fi here? — Yes, there is.

quiz.sentence: There ___ a bus stop near my house.
quiz.ko: 우리 집 근처에 버스 정류장이 있어요.
quiz.why: a bus stop은 하나라서 There is

quiz.sentence: There ___ two bathrooms in the house.
quiz.ko: 그 집에는 화장실이 두 개 있어요.
quiz.why: two bathrooms는 둘 이상이라 There are

quiz.sentence: There ___ any bread in the kitchen.
quiz.why: bread는 셀 수 없는 것이라 isn't

quiz.sentence: Are there any chairs? — Yes, there ___.
quiz.why: Are there로 물었으니 Yes, there are.

quiz.answer: There's some milk in the fridge.
choices: There are some milk in the fridge.
There's some milk in the fridge.
There has some milk in the fridge.
It have some milk in the fridge.
quiz.why: milk는 셀 수 없어서 There is(There's)

quiz.answer: Is there a beach near here?
choices: Are there a beach near here?
Is there a beach near here?
quiz.why: 하나를 물을 때 Is there + a ~?

quiz.answer: There are two windows in the room.
choices: There are two windows in the room.
There is two windows in the room.
There have two windows in the room.
There are two window in the room.
quiz.why: 둘 이상이면 There are, window도 windows로
buses는 여러 개라서 There aren't any + 복수

quiz.answer: There are five people in my share house.
choices: There is five people in my share house.
There have five people in my share house.
There are five peoples in my share house.
There are five people in my share house.
quiz.why: people은 여러 명이라 are, 이미 복수라서 s를 붙이지 않아요

quiz.answer: Is there a toilet on this train?
choices: Is there a toilet on this train?
Are there a toilet on this train?
There is toilet on this train?
Has there a toilet on this train?

quiz.why: sugar는 셀 수 없어서 There isn't any
